title: Patanjali Enters Your General Insurance World: What It Means
description: Patanjali Ayurved, known for its FMCG products, has now entered the general insurance business. It has acquired Magma General Insurance, along with the DS Gro.

faq.q: What kind of insurance does "general insurance" cover?
faq.a: General insurance covers non-life assets and risks, including motor insurance for your vehicle, health insurance for medical expenses, home insurance for property damage, and travel insurance for trips.

faq.q: Who is the DS Group mentioned in the acquisition?
faq.a: The DS Group is a diversified Indian conglomerate with interests in various sectors, including FMCG, hospitality, packaging, and infrastructure. They are partnering with Patanjali in this acquisition.

faq.q: Will Magma General Insurance's name change to Patanjali Insurance?
faq.a: The immediate effect of the acquisition is that Patanjali becomes the promoter of Magma General Insurance. While a name change is possible in the future, it's not an immediate outcome of the approval.

faq.q: How does IRDAI regulate such acquisitions?
faq.a: IRDAI ensures that the acquiring entities meet strict financial and operational criteria. Their approval process protects policyholders and maintains stability in the insurance market.
